title: vault_report
description: What one vault sync did (OpenSpec markdown-vault): counts, one event per output line, warnings, the cursor it ended on; a dry run adds the planned ops and files.

written.description: project files and task notes written

created.description: tasks created from new lines and new task notes

updated.description: tasks changed, completed or reopened from the files

trashed.description: tasks trashed because their line was removed

notes.description: standalone notes in Notes/ (OpenSpec vault-notes), absent while the vault's notes are off

trashed.description: notes trashed because their file was deleted

notes.description: notes the vault holds after the sync

planned.description: dry run: the ops that would be sent

files.description: dry run: the files that would be written
